title: PlayStation 2: planned, and open to requests
body: PlayStation 2 is planned for OpenPak and not yet built. Like the original Xbox, the Wii and the DS, its online games predate accounts and push notifications, so the work will be per-game rather than a single system-wide network. Thirty PlayStation 2 titles can be requested from the catalogue today. Nothing is live yet, and we will not claim online play for any game until it has been played on a real console.
footer: OpenPak Networks — built in the open.
